info.title: v2.logistics.set_mart_packaging_info
info.description: [Only for ID mart seller] This API allows sellers to set up their packaging fee info. Through this API, sellers can enable or disable packaging fees, and if enabled, specify the dimensions of the packaging and the associated fee. This ensures that sellers can configure their shipping costs accurately based on their packaging requirements.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Required if enabled is set to True.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Indicates whether the seller has enabled or disabled the packaging fee configuration. True: The seller charges a packaging fee. False: The seller does not charge a packaging fee.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the packaging in centimetres (cm).

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length of the packaging in centimetres (cm).

parameters.name: packaging_fee
parameters.description: Required if enabled is set to True.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The packaging fee price in your region's local currency. For SG/MY/BR/MX seller: Sellers can set the price with two decimal place, other regions can only set the price as an integer.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the packaging in centimetres (cm).

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/set_mart_packaging_info?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "dimension": {
        "height": 15,
        "length": 15,
        "width": 15
    },
    "enable": true,
    "packaging_fee": {
        "value": 100.00
    }
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
